board.dimension_rationale: 120 mm board height preserves the shared 120 mm-class Air cooling envelope; 180 mm width leaves separate left input and right control/service zones outside the central cooling footprint.

domain_a.routing_intent: stacked regulator pair directly above row; VCORE enters row vertically with short broad copper; series-domain ladder runs horizontally through four ASIC positions.

domain_b.routing_intent: stacked regulator pair directly below row; VCORE enters row vertically with short broad copper; series-domain ladder runs horizontally through four ASIC positions.

placement_rules: No regulator power-stage component may enter the 70 x 40 mm ASIC cold-plate contact rectangle.
Each two-regulator stack must remain adjacent to its own four-chip row; cross-domain VCORE routing is forbidden.
High-current VCORE transition from each VRM zone to its ASIC row is targeted at <=15 mm before detailed routing.
PMBus, reset, UART level shifting, temperature sensing and other low-current control may occupy the right-side level-shift/telemetry zone.
12 V distribution may enter both VRM zones from the left, but the old four-branch VRM topology is invalid.
Air and Hydro use identical PCB coordinates and mounting holes unless physical thermal validation later forces a variant-specific exception.

source_constraints.gamma_hex: Open Gamma Hex establishes multi-ASIC domain precedent: six BM1370 as two domains of three and a four-phase TPS546D24S regulator.
source_constraints.tps546d24s: TI package is 7 x 5 mm, 40 A each, stackable; placement zone includes regulators plus still-unselected inductors/capacitors and is not a footprint release.

unresolved_before_routing: four-chip series-domain node ordering and level-shifter implementation
stacked TPS546D24S layout copied/adapted from a validated reference implementation
